ui_bugs.issue: Infinite render loop: useEffect at line 30-40 has dependency array [hb, lang, tri] but `tri` is a fresh arrow function recreated every render (line 17). Each setEvents(newArrayRef) → re-render → new tri identity → effect re-fires → setEvents again → 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. Console spammed with the warning; master-console interactivity blocked (shift-briefing overlay cannot be dismissed cleanly because React keeps re-rendering).

action_items:
FIX EmergencyCenter.jsx useEffect dependency: remove `tri` from the deps array (keep only [hb, lang]) OR memoize tri with useCallback/useMemo. Suggested minimal patch:
  useEffect(() => { ... }, [hb, lang]);  // drop `tri` — it's captured lexically and doesn't need to trigger the effect
Alternatively wrap tri: `const tri = useCallback((...args) => mkTri(lang)(...args), [lang]);` and keep it in deps.

Audit other newly-refactored consumers (DigitalTwin, AgvFleet, TimelineTurno) for the same anti-pattern. DigitalTwin uses [hb] only — OK. AgvFleet uses [hb, lang] — OK. TimelineTurno uses [load] with load memoized on [lang] — OK.
After fix, re-run full E2E: SOS create → emergency-active within ~4s → ack → timeline-ev-<i> red marker → supplier email save persistence → role fornaio hides panel-timeline → 390px no page overflow.

rca of the issue: React infinite loop in /app/frontend/src/components/EmergencyCenter.jsx. Line 17 defines `const tri = (i, d, e, s, f, fa) => mkTri(lang)(i, d, e, s, f, fa);` — a NEW function reference each render. Line 40 lists it as effect dependency: `}, [hb, lang, tri]);`. Consequence: every state update inside the effect (setEvents on line 33) triggers a re-render, which recreates `tri`, which causes React to re-run the effect, which calls setEvents again with a freshly filtered array reference — even when the filtered content is identical the identity differs, so state 'changes' and the cycle repeats until React aborts with 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. Repro: authenticate + set localStorage mikilab_admin_unlocked=1 & mikilab_plancia_role=tutto and load the app → console floods with the warning within ~1s of master-console mount. Mitigation: remove tri from deps (safe: it only reads lang which is already a dep), or memoize tri via useCallback([lang]).
